question:
The requirements analysis of a certain enterprise management system is as follows:
1. Employee management: including employee information, job assignment, performance appraisal, salary number, creation time, update time, etc. An employee can participate in multiple projects.
2. Supplier management: including supplier information, supplier relationship management, creation time, update time, etc. A supplier can supply multiple projects.
3. Project management: including project information, project progress management, creation time, update time, etc. A project contains multiple employees and can have multiple suppliers.
4. Attendance management: including employee number, employee clock-in, attendance record, creation time, update time, etc.
5. Salary management: including salary payment, salary calculation, creation time, update time, etc.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0388
CREATE TABLE `employees` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `job_title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `salary` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `projects` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `project_employees` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `employee_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `project_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `project_employees_ibfk_1` (`employee_id`),
  KEY `project_employees_ibfk_2` (`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_employees_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employees` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `project_employees_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `suppliers` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `project_suppliers` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `supplier_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `project_suppliers_ibfk_1` (`project_id`),
  KEY `project_suppliers_ibfk_2` (`supplier_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_suppliers_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `project_suppliers_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`supplier_id`) REFERENCES `suppliers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `attendance` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `employee_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `clock_in` datetime NOT NULL,
  `attendance_record` text,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `attendance_ibfk_1` (`employee_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `attendance_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employees` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `salary_payments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `employee_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `salary` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `salary_payments_ibfk_1` (`employee_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `salary_payments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employees` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
